title: Earlier weatherman burned by tall white suits at Range Four
summary: Charles Hall tells of Earlier weatherman burned by tall white suits at Range Four, about before 1965 at Range Four, Indian Springs Valley; Nellis hospital, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Range Four, Indian Springs Valley; Nellis hospital, Nevada

tellings.quote: and the suit and his shoulder almost touched one of the shoes. And I saw his x-rays and pictures.

plain: A former Air Force weather observer named Charles Hall, who says he spent years in contact with tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites in the Nevada desert, tells of a weatherman who worked there before him, sometime before 1965. According to Hall, that man was at Range Four, a military range in Indian Springs Valley, when his shoulder almost touched one of the beings' suits, and he was burned. Hall says he saw the man's x-rays and pictures at the hospital at Nellis, a nearby Air Force base, which, if true, would be physical proof of the contact.
